paras: Sceloporus palaciosi, also known commonly as Palacios's bunchgrass lizard, Palacios' bunchgrass lizard, and la lagartija arborícola de Palacios in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is endemic to Mexico.
The specific name, palaciosi, is in honor of Prococo Palacios of Comunidad Rancho el Capulin, Mexico.
Sceloporus palaciosi is found in the Mexican states of Guerrero, Mexico, and Morelos.
The preferred natural habitat of Sceloporus palaciosi is forest, at elevations of 2,700–4,400 m (8,900–14,400 ft).
The mode of reproduction of Sceloporus palaciosi has been described as viviparous and as ovoviviparous.
